name: bench-cradle-empty-a
refs: Our signed bench stage (project-owned): match its housing materials (sage enamel, sand trim, dark slate floor, screws), its matte painterly rendering and its light from the top exactly.

The outline of the recess to paint (project-owned guide): the dark shape is the exact footprint of the device lying on its back, its rounded end to the left and its antenna end to the right. The light grey is the tray around it.
The device that will lie in the cradle later (project-owned, approved): for its size and shape only. Do not draw the device.
prompt: Paint one empty cradle on a work tray, seen from above at a slight three-quarter angle, filling the frame: a shallow padded recess in a sage enamel tray with a sand trim, shaped exactly to the dark outline in the second reference (rounded end left, a narrow channel for the antenna on the right, a small notch for the carry loop), lined with dark matte rubber padding, the tray sitting on the dark slate floor of the first reference. The recess is EMPTY: no device, no screen, no eggs, no plates in it. Matte painterly rendering exactly as the first reference, light from the top, a soft flat shadow inside the recess's upper lip. Plain and functional, like a charging dock. No text, no glow, no lamps, no hoses, no people, no hands, no frame border.
